questions.question: A grammar is ambiguous. Can it be SLR(1)?
questions.solutionApproach: No — ambiguous grammars can NEVER be LR(k) for any k (SLR/LALR/LR(1) are all specific LR(k) variants). Ambiguity guarantees a shift-reduce or reduce-reduce conflict will arise somewhere in the parsing table.
questions.answer: No — ambiguous grammars are never LR(k) for any k, including SLR(1).
